candidates.value: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries (MHI) TD03 family, small-diameter, single-scroll; 11-blade reshaped turbine with diagonal exhaust entry on 2022-2024 Civic
candidates.evidence: For maximum responsiveness, a small-diameter MHI TD03 turbo is used. The single-scroll housing design helps the turbo build boost even at relatively small throttle openings and low engine speeds. … In the latest Civic the engine also uses a reshaped 11-blade turbine impeller design in the turbocharger … Exhaust channeled to the turbo now enters the turbine wheel diagonally, rather than from the side as before.

applicability.notes: Honda 1.5T technical release; Civic Sedan EX/Touring share the same code and ratings per the same table

candidates.notes: The 'Turbo System' section describes all 1.5T versions; the 11th-gen section adds the 11-blade turbine. Exact TD03 sub-model/trim not published.

candidates.evidence: a low-inertia mono-scroll turbo system that uses an electric wastegate to control boost pressure … The electrically actuated wastegate enables precise control of boost pressure.

applicability.notes: Honda 1.5T technical release; Civic Sedan EX/Touring share the same code and ratings per the same table

candidates.value: Air-to-air, front-mounted low in the front of the car, resin composite inlet pipes

candidates.value: Negligible turbo lag; quick throttle response (small-diameter turbine)
candidates.evidence: Thanks to careful tuning and use of a relatively small-diameter turbine wheel, the Honda version of the forced-induction engine exhibits negligible turbo lag—a phenomenon that bedevils many of its turbocharged competitors—so response to the throttle is quick.
candidates.notes: Marketing description; consistent with the rated torque plateau starting at 1700 rpm. No measured spool time found.

turbo.boost_onset_rpm.description: Engine speed at which full-load boost is reached (WOT, steady)

candidates.how_to_measure: WOT pull in 3rd/4th from 1200 rpm with OBD-II MAP (or Hondata/KTuner log) at 10 Hz+: record MAP vs rpm.
candidates.notes: Inference: the rated 177 lb-ft plateau begins at 1700 rpm (class A), which on a turbo engine requires near-target boost there. Not a measurement; no public stock 11th-gen boost log was found (Hondata/KTuner logs not public/accessible).

turbo.boost_taper.description: Boost vs rpm above the torque plateau

candidates.how_to_measure: Same WOT log as boost_onset_rpm to the limiter; torque falls from 177 lb-ft at 4500 to ~158 lb-ft at 6000 (computed from rating), so boost is expected to taper, but only a log shows it.
searches: PRL/TSP/Hondata dyno pages (no boost traces for stock)

turbo.torque_management.description: Torque limiting by gear / torque management (6MT)

candidates.how_to_measure: WOT logs in 1st, 2nd and 3rd from the same rpm: compare MAP and calculated load; a lower 1st/2nd plateau indicates per-gear torque limits.
searches: civicxi tuning threads (tuners mention raised boost limits, no stock per-gear tables)
